layoutProfile.name: wide-desktop-reference
layoutProfile.description: Approximate wide-window Excel 2021 ribbon layout for visual reconstruction and quiz rendering.

coordinateSystem.rowMeaning: Small controls normally occupy one of three vertical rows. Large controls generally span all three rows.
coordinateSystem.columnMeaning: Logical position within each group, not pixel coordinates.

layoutProfile.importantNote: This is a renderer-oriented model, not an official Microsoft ribbon export. Excel's actual ribbon is responsive and may rearrange, hide, or collapse controls depending on build, window width, selected object, enabled services, and licensing.
